resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page lists the Virginia Department of Forestry; the register says the tower is now privately owned and names no agency. The record's agency field is probably out of date. No date given for the change.

notes_for_editor: Register says the tower is privately owned and no longer a lookout; no date for that change, no owner named. Forest Lookouts names VDOF as agency, so the record's agency field may be stale. No staffing, fire or access sources found; two searches turned up nothing on the tower's history. A search also turned up a 125-foot Southside Electric pole in Blackstone, which is not this lookout. The 1942 date may be the build year or first record; the sources do not say which.
